nodes.name: isDead
nodes.signature: function isDead(PoolId id) external view returns (bool)

nodes.name: _getCurrentBucket

nodes.reachability: Private view, one call site at `_getCurrentBucket` (CauldronHook.sol:1654). Pure wall-clock arithmetic on the block timestamp, which is what makes the window mean the same thing on a chain whose block numbers track a parent chain.

nodes.name: _getHolderTaxRate
nodes.signature: function _getHolderTaxRate(address holder) private view returns (uint256)

nodes.name: setDefaultTaxBps
nodes.signature: function setDefaultTaxBps(uint256 _bps) external onlyOwner

nodes.name: releaseRelaunchETH
nodes.signature: function releaseRelaunchETH() external returns (uint256 amount)
nodes.reachability: Registry-only, and the counter is zeroed BEFORE the send at `relaunchETH` (CauldronHook.sol:1857), so it is checks-effects-interactions. A zero balance reverts `NoETHToRelease` (CauldronHook.sol:1855) rather than returning zero, and a failed send reverts `SendFailed` (CauldronHook.sol:1860) — which rolls the zeroing back, so the counter and the balance cannot silently diverge here. nodes.signature: function releaseRelaunchAsset(address asset) external returns (uint256 amount)
nodes.reachability: Registry-only, per-asset counterpart to the native release. The mapping entry is zeroed before the move at `relaunchAsset` (CauldronHook.sol:1885) and the library's boolean IS checked at `send` (CauldronHook.sol:1886), so a token that returns false rather than reverting cannot zero the counter while the tokens stay put. nodes.name: renounceOwnership
nodes.signature: function renounceOwnership() public view override onlyOwner

This contract inherits Ownable directly rather than through CauldronBase, so the base contract's own guard never covered this selector (DERIVED). Because the `onlyOwner` modifier still runs first (CauldronHook.sol:1913), a non-owner caller gets Ownable's unauthorized error and only the owner reaches `RenounceDisabled` (CauldronHook.sol:1914) - the two callers are distinguishable by revert data (DERIVED). Declared `view` while reverting, which is legal and keeps the selector non-payable and gas-free to probe (DERIVED).

nodes.name: setDeathThreshold
nodes.signature: function setDeathThreshold( uint256 _threshold, address _oracle, uint256 _volumePerNFT, uint256 _nftPriceStep, uint256 _oddsFullVolume ) external onlyOwner

A zero oracle argument leaves the oracle and the curve untouched while still moving `deathThreshold` (CauldronHook.sol:1968) — and there is no way to UNSET an oracle once set, because address(0) is the leave-alone sentinel.

nodes.name: forceClosePerps
nodes.signature: function forceClosePerps() external
nodes.reachability: Registry-only, called once per rebirth. It raises the transient relaunch flag at `_inRelaunchClose` (CauldronHook.sol:1988) so the engine's settlement swaps skip fee and buyback, force-closes inside try/catch, then lowers it at `_inRelaunchClose` (CauldronHook.sol:1990). The flag is transient, so it clears at end of transaction even if the close reverts. The final survivor check at `openCount` (CauldronHook.sol:2015) is NOT guarded and reverts `PerpsOpen` (CauldronHook.sol:2015) on any leftover, which deliberately unwinds the caller's whole relaunch rather than stranding positions.

nodes.name: setLiveKey
nodes.signature: function setLiveKey(PoolKey calldata k) external
nodes.reachability: Registry-only, pushed at every summon and relaunch. It is a plain storage write with NO validation of the key at `_liveKey` (CauldronHook.sol:2048) — not the currencies, not the fee, not the hook field — so the registry alone decides which pool the buyback spends into and which currency1 the credit gate at `_liveKey` (CauldronHook.sol:937) compares against.

nodes.name: liveKey
nodes.signature: function liveKey() external view returns (PoolKey memory)
nodes.reachability: External view returning the whole struct; the canonical pool for integrators. Same data the internal paths read at `_liveKey` (CauldronHook.sol:1089).

nodes.name: setLegacyBuyback

The share is bounded by `BPS` (CauldronHook.sol:2061) at 100 percent of the post-guild fee, and a zero threshold argument leaves the existing threshold alone at `legacyThreshold` (CauldronHook.sol:2064).

nodes.name: setDeathChecker

nodes.authority_gate_quote: if (msg.sender != registry && msg.sender != owner()) revert OnlyRegistry(); (CauldronHook.sol:2074)

nodes.name: setPolicies

nodes.name: setFeeRouter

It is still a call made mid-swap into an admin-chosen address, so it is a re-entrancy surface into the fee path.

nodes.name: setNftContract
nodes.signature: function setNftContract(address _nft) external onlyOwner
nodes.reachability: Owner-only, unvalidated. It selects the contract every swap asks for a tax tier at `INFTContract` (CauldronHook.sol:1824), so it directly controls what every trader pays, bounded only by the combined clamp at `MAX_TOTAL_FEE_BPS` (CauldronHook.sol:1595).

nodes.name: setRegistry
nodes.signature: function setRegistry(address _registry) external onlyOwner

nodes.name: executeRegistryOverride
nodes.signature: function executeRegistryOverride() external onlyOwner

nodes.signature: function setCollection(address _collection) external

nodes.name: _wireLiquidator

nodes.name: setVault
nodes.signature: function setVault(address _vault) external

nodes.name: setQuest

nodes.name: setSeeder

nodes.authority_gate_quote: if (msg.sender != registry && msg.sender != owner()) revert OnlyRegistry(); (CauldronHook.sol:2226)

nodes.name: setPerpEngine

nodes.authority_gate_quote: if (msg.sender != registry && msg.sender != owner()) revert OnlyRegistry(); (CauldronHook.sol:2234)

nodes.name: setFloorBps
nodes.signature: function setFloorBps(uint256 _bps) external onlyOwner

nodes.name: setGuildBps
nodes.signature: function setGuildBps(uint256 _bps) external onlyOwner

nodes.name: setActiveProposer
nodes.signature: function setActiveProposer(address who) external

nodes.name: setProposerBps
